# P1.8 eligibility boundaries

These synthetic, anonymized raw hands are format-faithful to the documented
2026-07-21 100 BB `$0.02/$0.05` CoinPoker HUNL evidence. `supported_2_4bb`
is the selected BTN/SB-open/BB-call flop baseline. Every other hand changes
exactly one eligibility fact from it.

`actual_splash_drop.txt` preserves the documented real CoinPoker spelling and
amount, `SPLASH dropped 0.40`, while holding the normal cohort facts fixed.
It tests the actual parser/ledger event rather than an invented flag.
